production.direction_en: Captain Rusk raises a signal banner over the orchard road. A volley is already aimed at the well.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_tension, snare roll under the signal banner | battle: bgm_boss_human | post: bgm_ledger_motif on 'Seven notches'

commands.speaker: rusk
commands.text: The order says the heir comes quietly. It says nothing about the village.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Your order is written by cowards.

commands.speaker: rusk
commands.text: It was sealed by someone the Crown buried years ago.
